title: the-ground-loop-pane-shows-its-state
why: A read-projection of the record, not a second source. The pane computes nothing about liveness; it renders what the loop wrote. Every surface is a view (the bus/one-web-server rule).

falsifier.proves_red: The pane displays a liveness the record does not say — i.e. it derives or caches rather than renders. And: the pane must be honest when the record is STALE or ABSENT, showing 'not running' or 'unknown' rather than blank or a last-known-good.

proved_2026-08-09: The heartbeat has a face. /device/ground_loop assembles through the STANDARD pane machinery: declared_panes() on the device offers one liveness pane whose data IS read_liveness(now) plus a single 'reports' label naming the resident record — render, never derive; the ruled 5s stays at its one address (liveness.py:39), and the absent case carries the read face's own named lack, never blank. GroundLoopShim (12 lines) fronts the HANDED chassis — constructor injection, no lazy second loop — and inherits active_page whole; the honest join is the loop subscribing its own shim at listener wiring, so ground_loop sits in the nav because the roster IS the subscription list (falsifier 5 of web_server stays whole). The self-subscription is inert under the beat (probes() default [] — measured by the recursion tooth). 21/21 teeth green twice + netns seal, 17 pre-existing bodies byte-unedited; server.py/render.py untouched — the declared-pane pattern held for its second real tenant. Live-fired three states on ONE listener, no restart: named lack -> LIVE pid 3221041 age 0.9s -> DEAD age 7.9s after SIGTERM. Verdict verdict-20260809T140503-4d3deeed27b7.json answers the chart (chain orient->validate 20260809, all deposited). Flagged for Akien's read, not a build fix: the page shows two truthful facts about two instances — the STATUS floor introspects the listener's in-process chassis (beats counting) while the liveness pane reports the resident singleton's record from disk; the 'reports' label names this, whether the framing needs more is his call.

cursor_correction_2026-07-30: Cast with the cursor at [BUILDME], corrected to [THINKME] within the hour. A cursor AT a stage means that stage was ENTERED — superclaude-starts-itself rests at [PROVEME] with its BUILDME gate already satisfied — so [BUILDME] on a freshly cast leaf claims a crossing that never rode the chokepoint. It cannot have: since ticket buildme-rides-the-chart (2026-07-29) the entry gate refuses a BUILDME crossing unless a berthed validate packet claims the ticket, and a census of all 89 berths finds ZERO claiming any ticket in this family. Hand-writing the cursor forward is precisely the hand-edit of a record of truth that transitions.emit exists to prevent (Law 4). The stage is reachable only by /chart, then the door.
the_threshold_this_renders: THE STALENESS THRESHOLD IS 5 SECONDS — five missed ticks at the ruled once-per-second cadence. Ruled by Akien 2026-07-31. Three times the interval is the standard liveness heuristic; five gives slack for a loaded box without anyone noticing the lag. LIVE = last-run within 5s. DEAD = last-run older than 5s, whatever the file says about state, whatever pid it names. A crashed loop leaves the file behind but STOPS ADVANCING THE TIMESTAMP — that is the whole detector, and it is Akien's, present in the design from the first telling.
honesty_requirement: The pane applies the same 5s rule as the start-guard and gets it from the same place — one implementation of a settled question (Law 1). A pane with its own opinion about how stale is dead is a second answer that will drift from the first.
